This Week at The Lakehouse 🦃 Thanksgiving Week · WinterLand
Monday November 23 – Sunday November 29, 2026
Quiet until Wednesday night, then four of the biggest days of the fall.
Thanksgiving Eve is the biggest bar night of the year — Shooters, XMAS World, and Old River Road all go late Wednesday. Saturday is WinterLand on Public Square (3-8 PM), Michigan at noon, A-Trak at Shooters. Sunday the Browns host the Raiders at 1 and the Cavs tip at 3:30. Cold all week, rain Thursday and Friday, Saturday is the dry one.
